validity: Thresholds are conventions chosen for reproducibility, calibrated to nothing yet (there is no benchmark corpus): a score is a pure function of the counters, not a measurement of quality.

styling.label: styling code is present in the audited folders
styling.note: no styling code in the audited folders: no markup or style files and no styling counter above 0

limits: Drift control is the clean-file share over all audited files, so adding files with no styling raises it: the dirty-file count is printed beside it and flagged from 20 files.
Dirty files are an upper bound: min(files with colour hits, literal colour hits); calls with a var() argument are token references and are not counted as literals.

A declared exemption is not applied to colour hits (the counters carry no such split), though it is applied to font-size, spacing and radius counts elsewhere; the with and without mockup colour hits are separate lines.

drift_control.label: Drift control: audited files with no raw colour-literal hit (a colour call with a var() argument is not a literal)

ratio.zero_note: the scanner audited no files: drift control not rated

classes.label: Colour literals (hex, rgb/hsl/oklch calls) outside the token source

lines.label: Colour hits inside the token source (exempt from the scan)
Share of all colour hits that sit in the token source
Raw px hits inside the token source (exempt from the scan)
Share of all px hits that sit in the token source
Colour hits in the token source per custom-property declaration (above 2 the token source may hold ordinary rules)

ratio.zero_note: the token source declares no custom property

lines.label: Colour hits in files whose path contains 'mockup'
Colour hits excluding files whose path contains 'mockup'
Colour hits that are calls with a var() argument (token references, not counted as literals)
Colour hits that are raw literals (total minus var()-based)
Audited files with a raw colour literal, upper bound min(files with colour hits, literal hits)
Colour hits in files unreachable from any entry point
Exemptions the drift script applies that guardrails.mdx never names (reported, not applied)

flags.text: the audited folders hold as many test files as audited files: test files are left out of every share, so a file renamed *.test.* or moved under __tests__/ is not audited
colour calls whose argument is var() are token references: they are left out of the dirty-file count, which is therefore the upper bound min(files with colour hits, literal colour hits)
20 or more audited files hold raw colour literals: a high clean share over a large population does not mean few files drift, read the file count beside the share
the token source holds more than 2 raw colour literals per custom-property declaration: it may hold ordinary rules, which the scan exempts and no score sees

ratio.zero_note: the token source declares no custom property

flags.text: the token source holds more than 2 raw px values per custom-property declaration: it may hold ordinary rules, which the scan exempts and no score sees

ratio.zero_note: the token source declares no custom property
